exposure: trial of labor after cesarean delivery
outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) success rate
cohort: 7043 women (2749 grand multiparous and 4294 multiparous) who underwent TOLAC
finding: Trial of labor after cesarean in grand multiparous women was associated with favorable maternal and neonatal outcomes but a higher risk of postpartum hemorrhage and prolonged hospitalization.
